name: Dr. Fabian Uhrich
headline: CPO Quicklizard | Pricing Expert | exBCG Partner | Business Angel
summary:
Expert for marketing, sales & pricing - from B2B to B2B2C and B2C - online, offline and multi-channel - leveraging analytics and automation - building capabilities and enabling people.

As CPO of Quicklizard I am responsible for our offering making sure we generate the maximum value with pricing for our clients today and in the future.
To achieve that, I bring in my extensive pricing experience from my times as Partner and global expert for pricing at the Boston Consulting Group and as Head of Pricing & Online Marketing at Zooplus, Europe’s largest online pet supplies shop. On top, I have a Doctor's degree in behavioral pricing from TU Munich and stay at the pulse of research as resident guest lecturer at ETH Zurich.

company.name: Quicklizard
company.tagline: Quicklizard | AI-driven Dynamic Pricing & Competitive Intelligence Platform for Omnichannel Retailers and Brands
company.description:
Quicklizard is a leading AI powered dynamic pricing platform, helping retailers and eCommerce companies automate and optimize pricing across their entire product catalog and all sales channels.

In today’s complex retail environment, where millions of prices must be managed daily across markets, competitors, and channels, pricing can no longer rely on manual processes or gut feeling.

Quicklizard enables businesses to move to a more data driven and proactive approach, combining advanced analytics, machine learning, and flexible pricing strategies. Our platform keeps pricing transparent and controllable, while allowing teams to scale decisions across the business.

The result is faster and better pricing decisions, improved margins, and the ability to stay competitive in dynamic markets.
